units.unitTitle: Origin and Development of Persian Language
topics: Indo-Aryan family of languages
Development of Persian script and phonetic changes: Development of Iranian scripts, Cuneiform, Avestan Alphabet, Pahlavi Script
Avestan language: Its importance, its literature, its poetic style
Pahlavi language: Pahlavi literature, Poetry in Pahlavi language
Modern Persian: Development of Modern Persian
The Period of Tahirid Dynasty (820-872), Saffarid Dynasty (860-903), Samanid Empire (874-999)
The Earliest poets of Persian language: Abu Hafs Sughdi, Hanzala Badghisi, Firoz Mashriqi, Abu Sulik Gurgani, Mohammad bin Wasif, Abu Shakoor Balkhi, Hakim Kasai Marozi, Rudki Samarqandi, Daqiqi Tusi
Recommended Books to be studied: Tafsir-e Tabri, Kitabul Buldan
Recommended Poets to be studied: Unsuri, Farrukhi Sistani, Manuchehri Damaghani, Ferdowsi Tusi

Recommended Poets to be studied: Baba Taher Uryan, Abu Sa'eed Abul Khair, Khawja Abdullah Ansari, Sanai Ghaznavi, Fariduddin Attar, Asadi Tusi, Nasir Khusraw, Masud Sa'd Salman, Omar Khayyam, Amir Mu'izzi, Anvari Khavarani, Zahir Faryabi, Khaqani Shirvani, Nizami Ganjavi
Recommended Books to be studied: Kashaful Mahjoob, Tazkeratul aulia by Attar, Siyasat Nama, Qabus Nama, Marzuban Nama

units.unitTitle: Period of Mongol and Timurid Empire
topics: Recommended Poets to be studied: Sa'di Shirazi, Jalaluddin Rumi, Kamaluddin Ismail, Amir Khusrau, Khawjo Kirmani, Salman Saoji, Hafiz Shirazi, Nooruddin Jami
Recommended Books to be studied: Tarikh-e Jahangusha, Tabaqat-e Nasiri, Lubab ul Albab, Tazkera-e Daulatshah Samarqandi, Akhlaq-e Nasiri, Akhlaq-e Mohsini, Anwarus Suhaili, Nafhaatul Uns

units.unitTitle: Period of Safavid and Qachari Dynasties
topics: Recommended Poets to be studied: Baba Fughani, Wahshi Bafqi, Mohtasham Kashani, Saib Tabrezi, Mushtaq Esfahani, Azar Baigdili, Hakim Qaani, Eraj Mirza, Malikushura Bahar, Arif Qazwaini, Lahuti, Farrukhi Yazdi, Parveen Etesami
Recommended Books to be studied: Tarikh-e Alam Ara-e Abbasi, Habibus Siyar, Tazkira-e Haft Iqlim, Nasikhut Twarikh

During the Sultanat Period - Recommended Poets: Tajuddin Reeza, Shihabuddin Mahmara, Amir Khusrau, Hasan Sijzi; Recommended Books: Jawameul Hikayaat, Tajul Maasir, Fawaidus Salikeen, Tarikh-e Firoz Shahi
Persian Literature in Deccan - Recommended Poets: Zahuri Turshezi, Malik Qummi

During the Mughal Empire - Recommended Poets: Urfi Shirazi, Faizi, Naziri Nishapuri, Talib Amli, Abutalib Kalim, Abdul Qadir Bedil, Mirza Ghalib; Recommended Books: Tuzuk-e Baburi, Humayun Nama, Tuzuk-e Jahangiri, Akbar Nama, Muntakhabut Twarikh
During British Period - Recommended Poets: Allama Iqbal; Recommended Books: Sherul Ajam by Maulana Shibli Nomani, The Literary History of Persia by E. G. Brown
Recommended Poets to be studied: Nima Yushij, Farogh Farrukhzad, Ahmad Shamlo, Nadir Nadirpour, Mehdi Akhavan Sales, Rahi Mo'ayeri
Recommended Prose writers to be studied: Ali Akbar Dehkhuda, Sadiq Hidayat, Mohammad Ali Jamalzadeh, Buzurg Alavi, Ghulam Husain Saaedi

units.unitTitle: Study of different poetic and prose genres
units.unitTitleMr: विविध कविता आणि गद्य प्रकारांचा अभ्यास
topics: Classical forms of poetry: Qasida, Mathnavi, Ghazal, Rubai, Musammat
Modern forms of poetry: Sh'er-E Nimai, Sh'er-E Sapid
Rhetorics: Tajnees, Ishteqaq, Luzumma-la-yalzum, seyaqatul Aadad, Qalb, Tarsee, Esteaara, Maratun Nazir, Laff-o-Nashr, Husn-i-Taalil, Tajahuli-Aarefaneh, Talmih
Prosody: Bahr-I Muzara, Bahr-I Ramal, Bahr-I Mutaqarib, Bahr-i Hazaj
Different Style of Prose Writing: Nasr-E Sada, Nasr-e Masnoo, Nasr-e Shikasta
Influence of Sufi philosophy on Persian poetry and prose
Major historical events affecting Persian literature (e.g. Islamic conquest, Mongol invasions)
Persian influence on Indian art, music, and philosophy
Cultural contributions of Persian literature to Islamic and global civilization
Influence of Persian on Marathi Language and Literature
